title: Understanding Multimodality in Generative Behavioral Cloning
abstract: arXiv:2605.22493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Behavioral cloning becomes challenging when the same observation admits several valid actions. We study how generative behavioral-cloning policies represent such multimodal expert behavior and identify different bottlenecks across model parameterizations. For latent-variable policies, preserving demonstrated modes requires action-conditioned information in the latent representation. Excessive posterior-prior regularization can suppress this information and prevent the policy from distinguishing demonstrated modes. Weaker or aggregate regularization can preserve mode information, but shifts the challenge to ensuring that the deployment-time prior covers the relevant latent regions. For action-space generative policies, multimodality is constrained by the smoothness of the base-to-action transport: a map with a small Lipschitz constant cannot assign substantial probability to many well-separated modes. translated_title: 理解生成式行为克隆中的多模态性
translated_abstract: 当同一观测状态存在多个有效动作时，行为克隆变得具有挑战性。我们研究生成式行为克隆策略如何表示这种多模态的专家行为，并识别出不同模型参数化方式下的不同瓶颈。对于隐变量策略，保留演示中的模态需要隐表示中包含动作条件信息；过度的后验-先验正则化会抑制这种信息，导致策略无法区分演示的模态；而较弱或聚合的正则化虽然可以保留模态信息，却将挑战转移到确保部署时的先验覆盖相关的隐空间区域。对于动作空间生成策略，多模态性受限于从基础分布到动作空间的传输映射的平滑性：一个具有较小 Lipschitz 常数的映射无法为许多相互分离良好的模态分配可观的概率，因此要覆盖多个模态就需要……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文系统分析了生成式行为克隆策略表示多模态专家行为的机制，指出隐变量策略的瓶颈在于隐表示中动作条件信息的保留与先验覆盖，而动作空间生成策略的瓶颈在于传输映射的平滑性（Lipschitz 常数）限制了其表达多个分离模态的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes how generative behavioral cloning policies represent multimodal expert behavior, showing that latent-variable policies are bottlenecked by preserving action-conditioned information in the latent representation and ensuring prior coverage, while action-space generative policies are constrained by the smoothness (Lipschitz constant) of the base-to-action transport map, which limits their ability to cover well-separated modes.
